record.original_question: For a fibred surface f: S → B with genus g general fibre and with u_f the rank of the unitary flat summand U in the second Fujita decomposition of f_*ω_f, determine the general relation between u_f and the genus of the fibration. In particular, ask whether there is a Xiao-type lower bound for u_f, including in the isotrivial case.

evidence.quote: Problem: What is in general the relation between u f and the genus of the fibration? Is there a lower bound of Xiao type? Even the isotrivial case is not known.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $f: S \to B$ be a fibred surface, that is, a surjective morphism with connected fibres from a smooth complex projective surface $S$ onto a smooth complex projective curve $B$, whose general fibre is a smooth curve of genus $g \geq 2$. Let $\omega_f$ denote the relative dualizing sheaf and consider the Hodge bundle $f_*\omega_f$, a vector bundle of rank $g$ on $B$. By the second Fujita decomposition, $f_*\omega_f$ admits a splitting $f_*\omega_f = A \oplus U$, where $A$ is a locally free sheaf with ample Hodge-theoretic part and $U$ is the maximal unitary flat summand (i.e., the maximal subbundle coming from a unitary representation of $\pi_1(B)$). Let $u_f := \mathrm{rk}(U)$.

(a) Determine the general relation between the unitary rank $u_f$ and the genus $g$ of the fibration. In particular, decide whether there exists a Xiao-type lower bound for $u_f$ in terms of $g$ and the invariants of $f$.

(b) Answer the same question in the isotrivial case, namely when all smooth fibres of $f$ are mutually isomorphic.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work has produced upper bounds (e.g., u_f < g(5g-2)/(6g-3) for non-isotrivial fibrations, with maximal unitary rank u_f = g-1 forcing g ≤ 6) and slope/Clifford-index inequalities linking u_f and g, and there are constructions of locally non-trivial fibrations with maximal unitary rank. A definitive Xiao-type lower bound for u_f in terms of g (especially in the isotrivial case) does not appear to be established in full generality, so the problem is partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Fibred surfaces and their unitary rank
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the unitary rank u_f of the Hodge bundle of fibred surfaces, providing bounds relating u_f and g.
status_evidence.claim: Recent results give upper bounds on u_f in terms of g for non-isotrivial fibrations.

status_evidence.title: The slope of fibred surfaces: Unitary rank and Clifford index
status_evidence.snippet: Relates the slope inequality in Xiao's method to unitary rank and Clifford index.
status_evidence.claim: Xiao-method slope inequalities have been refined using the unitary rank.

status_evidence.title: Locally non-trivial fibred surfaces with maximal unitary rank
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs locally non-trivial examples achieving the maximal unitary rank.
status_evidence.claim: Boundary/extremal cases for u_f have been investigated.
